regime_adaptive_meta_selector.description: Regime-adaptive blending of pair strategies with multi-signal volatility/trend regime based de-risking using real data

basis.note: Exhaustively attempted Binance spot/futures basis via public endpoints.

funding_basis.note: Attempted real public Binance funding rates via REST endpoints; exhaustively attempted spot/futures basis. No fabricated IV/candles used.

bootstrap_ci_portfolio_oos.note: Bootstrap resampling of real-data portfolio period returns (no fabrication). 95% CIs reported.

cost_impact.note: Bootstrap CI of portfolio OOS returns net of realistic transaction costs (turnover x fee+slippage).

distinguishability_from_zero.note: Fraction of bootstrap paths with final equity <= 1.0 (breakeven). Lower is more distinguishable from zero.

assumptions.fallback_note: If real quote-volume is unavailable (blocked routes), the model falls back to a uniform participation assumption with slippage set to base_slippage. Nothing is fabricated; the failure is documented in blocked_routes and volume_fetch_status.
assumptions.note: Slippage scales with participation using real Binance quote volumes where available; no fabrication.

portfolio.note: VaR/CVaR/CDaR reported as positive magnitudes. CVaR is the mean of returns at or below VaR; CDaR is the mean of drawdowns at or below the drawdown VaR threshold.

permutation_test.note: Two-sided permutation p-value for the observed mean return against the null of no exploitable signal. Lower p-value is more distinguishable from zero.

regime_conditioned.note: Regime-conditioned portfolio performance on real Binance spot returns; computed from detect_regimes (BTC vol regime + BTC trend) over the portfolio return series.
